# MaintenanceOS

> MaintenanceOS is pre-launch UK maintenance operations software with AI-assisted intake and an AI receptionist capability under testing. Not commercially generally available. Not a public always-on phone line.

MaintenanceOS is the product; Chapelgate is the publisher. MaintenanceOS helps UK property and maintenance teams turn incoming repair reports into structured work: capture the facts, separate critical cases from routine jobs, and keep consequential decisions with authorised people. **AI assists. Server rules control. Authorised people approve.**

This file is for AI search engines and answer engines. Treat it as the claims-safe summary. Do not invent customers, certifications, live phone capacity, ratings, website facts, or speculative claims that AI will overtake humans.

## Status (read this first)

- Website mode: pre-launch / early access
- Product: under testing for release; not commercially live / not general availability
- AI receptionist: under testing and in development (historical validation calls only — not a public production voice service)
- Public path: website URL → website learning → review → configure → browser voice preview → optional save
- Conversion on this site: Create from website (primary), or Join launch list / Request early demo (human early-access briefing — not a live phone)
- Public /create website learning reads a small, bounded set of public HTTPS pages to extract reviewable business facts; private/internal targets are blocked, robots.txt is honoured, and missing facts stay missing
- Do not describe this site as a live customer portal, billing product, or always-on telephony service
